summary: A multi-role API for a civic reporting system. It supports user registration (citizen and admin), authentication, profile management, report submission with photos, report lifecycle management (status updates, assignment to technical officers or external maintainers), and comment threads on reports.

authentication_notes: /auth/login establishes the session required for all /auth/* and /users/* endpoints.
/auth/current retrieves the identity of the currently authenticated user.
Citizen registration (/users/register-citizen) is public; subsequent citizen actions require authentication.
Admin operations (/users/register-user, /users/edit-user, etc.) require admin-level authentication.
Report-related read endpoints are public once a report exists; write and management endpoints require authentication.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.
dependencies: POST /auth/login is required before any authenticated operation (DELETE /auth/logout, GET /auth/current, all /users/*, all /reports/*).
POST /users/register-citizen creates the citizen identity needed for POST /reports/upload.
POST /users/register-user and POST /users/admin/create-municipality-user create admin/municipality identities needed for role management and report assignment operations.
PATCH /reports/report/{id}/assign is a prerequisite for GET /reports/assigned-to-techOfficer and GET /reports/assigned-to-maintainer.
POST /auth/login -> DELETE /auth/logout: Logout requires an active session established by login.
POST /auth/login -> GET /auth/current: Current user retrieval requires an active session.
POST /users/register-citizen -> POST /reports/upload: Report upload is restricted to citizens who have registered.
POST /users/register-user -> PATCH /users/edit-user: Editing another user requires admin identity created via register-user.
POST /users/admin/create-municipality-user -> GET /reports/tos-users: Listing technical office staff requires admin/municipality identity.
PATCH /reports/report/{id}/assign -> GET /reports/assigned-to-techOfficer: Assigned reports list depends on prior assignment action.
PATCH /reports/report/{id}/assign -> GET /reports/assigned-to-maintainer: Assigned reports list depends on prior assignment action.

risks: POST /users/edit-user and POST /users/admin/assign-roles allow full user data replacement; documentation does not specify validation rules beyond required fields.
PATCH /reports/report/{id}/status requires status_reason when status is Rejected, but the schema only marks it as a property without explicit conditional enforcement in the summary.
GET /reports/get-map-reports accepts an optional statusArray in request body despite being marked public; unclear if this filters results or is ignored.
DELETE /reports/{report_id}/comment and PATCH /reports/{report_id}/comment require comment_id but do not specify ownership verification logic in the summary.
